3) Bridge letter: can you send a filled example showing the language around temporary attestation? That will help speed internal approvals.

Hi all — quick technical note to clarify PHI handling so HelioHealth can sign off: 

- Redwood inference receives raw text for model inference when customers call the hosted API. For HelioHealth’s plan, the integration will send patient IDs that are pseudonymized at the application layer; Redwood will not store long-term free-text PHI.
- Our recommended control: configure request routing to the dedicated tenant in us-west and enable prefix/KV cache disabled for endpoints that could contain PHI. We can document these controls in the bridge letter.
- We can include the following sentence in the bridge letter: "Redwood Inference does not persist unredacted PHI in long-term storage for HelioHealth and segregates inferences to a dedicated tenant with caching disabled for sensitive routes."

If you want, Ben, I can paste that exact language into the template and send back a PDF.

— Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
